# Sleeve

> Sleeve is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) video, audio and image downloader for Android 7.0 and newer, with no ads, tracking or accounts. It is a community fork of Seal that adds a multi-connection download engine, HLS/DASH support, gallery-dl coverage, and Spotify and Audible matching.

## Facts

- App name: Sleeve
- Package name: com.sleeve.app
- Platform: Android 7.0 (API 24) and newer; target SDK 35
- License: GPL-3.0
- Price: free, no ads, no subscriptions, no accounts
- Current release: 2.0.0-beta.10 (versionCode 200000302), arm64-v8a + x86_64
- Release APK: https://github.com/Burry071/sleeve/releases/latest/download/Sleeve-generic-release.apk
- Release APK SHA-256 (2.0.0-beta.10): 4f515709e27bb1e0444fa60816c0328e4db81d0ef4f59d12181c8cac95e32d93
- Signing certificate SHA-256: 2d5fd54b83c2b24d5fc267b8d082c936c44fd113db4267eb1c2f573a36adcad3
- Source repository: https://github.com/Burry071/sleeve

## What it supports

- 1,800+ sites through yt-dlp: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Twitter/X, SoundCloud and the full yt-dlp supported-sites list
- 500+ image hosts through gallery-dl: Instagram, Reddit, Imgur, Pixiv and others
- Direct file links with 8 parallel connections and resume
- HLS and DASH streams (m3u8, mpd) including AES-128
- Spotify playlists, albums and tracks, and Audible audiobooks via public metadata and ranked YouTube matches
- Format control: resolution, audio-only, subtitles, SponsorBlock, metadata embedding, filename templates
- DRM-protected content (Netflix, Disney+, Widevine) is not supported, by design
